literal: Even if spoken like those who are unattached, the words of those who do not hate will be quickly perceived.
translation: Even if they speak distantly like strangers, the true words of those who harbor no enmity will be quickly understood.
modern: அன்பில்லாத அயலாரைப் போலப் பேசினாலும், உள்ளத்தில் பகை இல்லாதவர்களின் உண்மையான குறிப்புச் சொற்கள் விரைவில் அறிந்துகொள்ளப்படும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how true affection can be recognized despite outward appearances. Sometimes lovers or friends may speak harshly or distantly, as if they have no attachment. However, because they do not actually harbor any hatred in their hearts, the underlying love in their words will be quickly perceived by the listener. The contrast between feigned detachment and genuine lack of enmity highlights the power of reading true intentions.
